5th Quarter Play of the Week: Week 5 winner

By Harrison Vapnek and Julia Keller
Published: Oct. 5, 2026 at 1:14 AM EDT
Add Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article

BALL, La. (KALB) - The results are in! The Tioga Indians are this week’s ‘Cool’ Play of the Week winners for the second straight week!

As Tioga was looking to seal a home victory over Jena, senior running back Jackson Tarver broke a pair of Giant tacklers and took it to the house for an Indians touchdown.

Thanks for voting, Cenla! Look out for our next poll with even more top plays immediately following Friday’s 5th Quarter on KALB.
